name: General Science Double Minor

requirements.title: Students complete 120 units, as specified below

sections.title: Minor Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must have their selection of minors for the BSc general science program approved by the program advisor as early in their program as possible.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Any two minors from the Faculty of Science may be combined to complete the BSc in general science program.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Alternatively, one minor from the Faculty of Science and one minor from outside the Faculty of Science can also be combined to complete the BSc in general science program.

sections.note: Note the Faculty of Science minimum unit requirements below.

requirements.title: One of BPK 110, BPK 140, BPK 142, BPK 143
One of EASC 101, EASC 103, EASC 104 and 3 more
One of STAT 201, STAT 203, STAT 205, STAT 270

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The following general requirements must be satisfied.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of 80 units in the Faculty of Science, of which at least 28 must be upper division.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A 2.0 grade point average (GPA) in upper division courses is required for each of the two subject area minors.

sections.note:
Note that some Departments have minimum grade requirements for prerequisite courses.
Consult departmental advisors about selection of upper division courses in subject minors.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
